mission: Study how to reduce reliance on animal slaughter while preserving nutritional adequacy, food safety, affordability, sustainability, and avoidance of potentially sentient suffering.

research_tracks.description: Balanced plant-forward diets and plant-based meat alternatives with adequate essential amino acids and nutrients
Fungal/microbial proteins and fermented ingredients; verify microorganism, feedstock and any animal-derived inputs
Grow animal muscle/fat cells from a documented cell bank without necessarily raising/slaughtering animals for each batch

ethical_audit_criteria.question: Was initial cell sourcing nonlethal, veterinary-reviewed, with donor welfare and any embryonic origin documented?
Were fetal bovine serum and other serum sources excluded or replaced with documented animal-component-free media?
Audit growth factors, scaffolds, enzymes, antibodies, processing aids, and their upstream supply chains.
Is production limited to appropriate muscle/fat cell culture without creating integrated neural tissue or animal subjects with potential pain perception?
Have the particular product's microbial, allergenic, toxicological and nutritional risks been independently reviewed by the applicable regulator?
Do verified energy mix, culture medium and process inventories demonstrate environmental performance at relevant scale?

empirical_hypotheses.question: Can selected affordable diets without slaughtered-animal meat meet complete nutrient requirements across studied population groups?
empirical_hypotheses.falsification: Demonstrable nutrient gaps, unacceptable health outcomes or food access gaps in the defined design.

empirical_hypotheses.question: Can audited serum-free cultivated meat materially reduce animal suffering and slaughter against a justified baseline?
empirical_hypotheses.falsification: Documented fetal serum dependence, lethal donor sourcing, induced sentient suffering, or worse welfare outcomes under measured conditions.

empirical_hypotheses.question: Under what production energy and culture-media systems is cultivated meat environmentally favorable?
empirical_hypotheses.falsification: Independently audited lifecycle inputs demonstrate comparable or higher harm than the comparator.

evidence.scope: Position paper; adequately planned adult vegetarian and vegan patterns can be nutritionally adequate; individualized planning still required.
US FDA regulatory framework and cell-bank/production review; not universal authorization.
Documents serum-free media research and uptake; industry advocacy source; independently verify company-specific claims.
Specific cell-cultured quail regulatory approval in Australia/New Zealand, not blanket all-products approval.
Review of animal-derived media/scaffold/process materials and alternatives.
Assessment methodology and limitations; not proof of universally lower emissions.

privacy: No participant-level health data or other identifiable records are included or published; future studies require informed consent and formal oversight.
